brief: Today's posts were dominated by reactions to the 6.2 Sol and Astra model release from OpenAI, with mixed reviews between influencers and users. The most notable beyond that was Devin's shift to multi-agent teams of persistent bots, and Replit's agent swarms launch.

themes.label: 6.2 Sol and Astra release
themes.summary: Builders praised the efficiency and speed of the new models while noting they still need work on taste and ease of use.

themes.label: Agent swarms and multi-agent teams
themes.summary: Builders described running many agents in parallel, with Replit launching swarms and Devin bots acting as persistent multi-agent teams.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Said Astra is his daily workflow automation model, running content publishing for Latent Space and AI Engineer. Also posted on Devin's multi-agent bot design and its persistent memory per bot.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Announced agent swarms on Replit, where spinning up many agents is now one prompt away. Also posted on using agent swarms to optimize software performance and on iOS-quality gestures on the web.

builders.name: Latent Space
builders.summary: Released a podcast episode with Andreas Blattmann and Dustin Podell of Black Forest Labs, covering latent diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and the Flux models.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Explained that mixed reviews of 6.2 Sol and Astra partly reflect late changes not retested. Said the models are very efficient and recommended trying 6.2 Sol ultrafast.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Noted the shifting model rankings on X, with Anthropic's 5.5 and Gemini's Carbon getting attention. Also posted a personal year-end reflection.

builders.name: Josh Woodward
builders.summary: Announced Gemini can now do tasks free in six countries, running on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, with features like calling businesses and paying via Google Pay.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Shared @every's full ratings for Astra and Sol 6.2, calling it a hard-to-remember frontier release. Also introduced an inverse @roon bench.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Highlighted OpenAI's cybersecurity-capable models and Vercel's DeepsecBench, a stealth benchmark. Also called agent-browser vitals a big deal for web performance.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Argued models have short shelf lives, so skills should work across any new model. Other posts were a personal joke and a claim about testing Astra 6.2 on website design.

builders.name: Sam Altman
builders.summary: Announced 6.2 Sol and Astra as out, token-efficient, with 6.2 Sol ultrafast highlighted. Said usability work will be prioritized in upcoming releases.

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.summary: Posted Daytona's macOS sandboxes for computer-use agents and announced a $30M seed investment in Remanence Labs focused on continual learning.

builders.name: Ryo Lu
builders.summary: Posted one short note that crazy ideas are now possible but still take care and effort.

builders.name: Garry Tan
builders.summary: Posted about a board shareholder vote and urged shareholders and employees to speak up. Other posts were brief reactions.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: All posts are personal or minor, including a visual share, a love of old commercials, and a one-shot prompt offer.
